function.name: restaurant_search
function.description: Searches for restaurants based on a list of preferred ingredients and maximum calorie count. Unlike recipe_search, which searches for recipes, this searches for restaurants.

ingredients.description: A list of ingredients you prefer in the restaurant's dishes.

calories.description: The maximum calorie count you prefer for the restaurant's dishes.

meal.description: Type of the meal for the restaurant's dishes, it's optional and could be breakfast, lunch or dinner. Default 'lunch'

function.name: ingredient_replace
function.description: Replaces an ingredient in a recipe with a substitute, keeping the calories below a certain number. Unlike recipe_search, which searches for recipes, this replaces an ingredient in a recipe.

original_ingredient.description: The ingredient in the recipe to replace.

replacement_ingredient.description: The substitute ingredient to replace the original one.

calories.description: The maximum number of calories for the recipe after replacement.

function.name: recipe_search
function.description: Searches for recipes based on a list of ingredients and a maximum caloric value. Unlike restaurant_search, which searches for restaurants, this searches for recipes.

ingredients.description: A list of ingredients you want to use in the recipe.

calories.description: The maximum number of calories for the recipe.

meal.description: Type of the meal for the recipe, it's optional and could be breakfast, lunch or dinner. Default 'lunch'
